question: Which country led the 2024 Global Gender Gap Report by closing over 90% of its gender gap?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Iceland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iceland** has consistently ranked at the top in the **Global Gender Gap Report**, including the 2024 edition.
 
• It is the only country that has successfully closed over **90% of its gender gap**, as per the report.
 
• The **Global Gender Gap Report** is an annual report published by the **World Economic Forum (WEF)** to measure gender parity across four key dimensions: **Economic Participation and Opportunity**, **Educational Attainment**, **Health and Survival**, and **Political Empowerment**.
 
• **Iceland**'s top position is attributed to its progressive policies on gender equality, including its efforts in ensuring equal pay, representation in political and economic sectors, and access to education and healthcare.
 
• Iceland has been a global leader in promoting **women empowerment** and has achieved significant milestones such as having **equal representation in parliament** and implementing laws that promote gender balance in corporate boards.
 
• The country's commitment to achieving **gender parity** is widely recognized as a model for other nations worldwide.
 
• Iceland's success highlights the importance of progressive policies and societal commitment to reducing gender disparities in various fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Finland**__

 __
 
• Finland is known for its **advanced social welfare system** and progressive policies on **gender equality**.
 
• It has been recognized for promoting **equal rights** in education, healthcare, and economic participation.
 
• Finland has also made significant strides in **women’s political participation**, with a high percentage of women in government roles.
 
 
 
• **Norway**__
 __
 
• Norway is widely regarded as a leader in **gender equality** and is consistently ranked among the top nations in the **Global Gender Gap Report**.
 
• The country enforces strict **equal pay laws** and has implemented measures to ensure **women’s representation** in leadership positions.
 
• Norway is also known for its **parental leave policies**, which promote gender equality in childcare responsibilities.
 
 
 
• **Sweden**__
 
 
• Sweden has a reputation for being one of the most **gender-equal countries** in the world.
 
• The country has implemented comprehensive policies to promote **gender parity** in workplaces, education, and governance.
 
• Sweden’s progressive stance on **gender equality** has resulted in substantial advancements, particularly in terms of **economic participation** and **political empowerment**.
